name: nginx
description: The official NGINX Open Source repository.
one_liner: The software that quietly runs a huge chunk of the internet's websites, routing and serving web traffic behind the scenes.
buyer: There's no fresh business opportunity in the repo itself — it's commodity infrastructure every hosting company and sysadmin already runs; the real buyer is an ops team wanting it tuned or secured.
business_use_cases: A managed-hosting company bundles pre-tuned NGINX configs as a 'performance package' add-on for clients' sites.
A consultant sells NGINX security-hardening and performance-tuning audits to companies running it in production.
An agency builds a reverse-proxy-as-a-service product on top of it for smaller companies without a dedicated ops team.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid NGINX configuration and performance audits to small and mid-size companies.
Sell a managed reverse-proxy hosting service built on it, billed monthly.

steal_this: Package a handful of battle-tested NGINX config templates (caching, rate-limiting, TLS) for one specific stack like WordPress or Node, and sell them as a $20 config pack this weekend.
